24417: Popura is a short 17-year-old high school student who works at Wagnaria. Ironically, she was named after the poplar tree so that she would grow tall. She is a hard worker, but she sometimes makes clumsy mistakes in her job.
24418: Souta is a high school student recruited by Popura to become a new employee at the family restaurant Wagnaria. He is enamored by cute things and thus favors Poplar over the other employees due to her cute appearance.
24419: Inami is a timid girl who joins the rest of the employees at Wagnaria. She has androphobia and is thus terrified of men; she punches any male that comes near her.
24420: Kyouko is the manager of Wagnaria. She usually maintains a rather apathetic attitude about how the restaurant is run and almost never bothers to do any work herself.
30685: A chef who works in the kitchen, Satou is a helpful but intimidating individual. He is in love with Yachiyo, but has problems expressing it. Of course, because she is so devoted to Kyouko, she fails to recognize any hints he attempts to make.
30686: A chef who works in the kitchen, he is a young man with an easygoing attitude. He often blackmails other workers to do his job for him and pass it off as a form of modesty from the other employees.
30905: Yachiyo is another employee at the restaurant. She usually carries around a katana which, according to her, was made by her parents who used to be blacksmiths. Yachiyo is unaware that some of the customers, and even Souta, are intimidated by her blade.
30906: Izumi, Souta's second eldest sister, is an author who tends to stay in her room for long periods of time focusing on working while ignoring the cleanliness of herself and her surroundings.
30907: Kazue is Souta's eldest sister. She is a lawyer and has the tendency to hit Souta with a law book.
30908: Kozue is Souta's third eldest sister. She's an alcoholic and appears to be drunk most of the time. She is a lonely girl who constantly faces rejection from other guys deep inside. She is also a very affectionate and physical girl who often hugs people around her.
30909: Nazuna is Souta's younger sister. She is very mature for her age and is already almost as tall as Souta even though she is only in elementary school. While a genuinely kind and caring person, she will manipulate other people to get her way.
32292: Aoi is a mysterious, self-proclaimed 16-year-old girl who Otoo meets on his travels to find his missing wife. He brings her back to Wagnaria where she starts working as a waitress and living in Wagnaria’s attic.
32294: Otoo is the top head of the restaurant. Most of the time he is away searching for his missing wife, but periodically returns to Wagnaria to check up on things and bring back souvenirs.
32299: Maya is an 18-year-old glasses-wearing girl who works at Wagnaria. She professes that she is a "normal person" striving to be completely ordinary in work and life in general.
43776: One of Kyouko's underlings. He is hardworking but clumsy.
44259: One of Kyouko's underlings and Youhei's twin sister. Like her brother, she is very hardworking yet clumsy. She works as an insurance saleswoman.
50931: Haruna is Hyougo Otoo's missing wife. She wanders the city by using manholes.
51755: Aoi's older brother who has been constantly searching for her. Like Aoi, his surname is an alias which coincidentally matches hers. He is the captain of the karate club and is strong enough to defend himself against Mahiru, who he gains a crush on.
